entities.summary: George Philip Nicholas Windsor, Earl of St Andrews, is a British philanthropist, former diplomat and a member of the extended British royal family. He was a member of the Diplomatic Service in New York and Budapest. St Andrews became chancellor of the University of Bolton in 2017. He is the trustee of the Next Century Foundation and patron of the Welsh Sinfonia. He is the elder son of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent, and Katharine, Duchess of Kent, and heir apparent to the dukedom of Kent. He is the second cousin of King Charles III and 43rd in the line of succession to the British throne as of 2025.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a member of the extended British royal family and trustee of the Next Century Foundation, Earl of St Andrews has played a significant role in philanthropic efforts and diplomatic service, particularly in New York and Budapest. His position as heir apparent to the dukedom of Kent also underscores his importance within the British monarchy.
